name: Legacy Truck Parts
old_description: When your truck is sidelined, every minute counts. Legacy Truck Parts specializes in rapid roadside delivery of premium truck parts in Las Vegas and the surrounding areas. From essential components like brake pads, alternators, and filters to hard-to-find specialty truck parts, our inventory is designed to get you back on the road fast. With our streamlined order process, you can request truck parts online or by phone, and our dedicated team will deliver directly to your location—day or night.
about:
Legacy Truck Parts operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, serving the surrounding region and extending into Kingman, Arizona. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available sources. It began as a parts supplier focused on keeping commercial trucks and trailers operational through rapid parts availability.

The business distributes a broad range of OEM and aftermarket truck and trailer components, covering categories such as air brakes, suspension, cooling, electrical, lighting, and power-train parts. It maintains a physical inventory at its Las Vegas facility and offers roadside delivery directly to disabled vehicles, as well as fleet support services. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are provided.

Customers include independent owner-operators and fleet managers in the trucking, transportation, and logistics sectors. The company's service area spans the Las Vegas metro area and reaches Kingman, Arizona, addressing both emergency breakdowns and scheduled maintenance needs.

Legacy Truck Parts emphasizes competitive pricing, a comprehensive selection from brands, and knowledgeable staff who assist with part identification. Its stated differentiator is the combination of immediate roadside delivery—available day or night—and a commitment to durable, reliable parts that keep trucks on the road.

name: Legend Electronics
old_description: Our company's objective is to continually improve in all aspects of our business through a customer-oriented quality management system. We are committed to ensuring that this policy is understood and implemented throughout the organization.
about:
Legend Electronics was founded in 1991 in Hawthorne, New York, as an independent stocking distributor of electronic components. The company began with a focus on hard-to-find and obsolete parts, building a global sourcing network to serve customers facing allocation, long lead times, and discontinued devices.

Today the distributor maintains a live inventory of 34,422 part numbers across 40,127 lots, each listed with date code, country of origin, packaging, and RoHS status. Its capabilities span global sourcing for semiconductors, ICs, memory, passives, connectors, relays, switches, and Mil-Spec components, along with shortage management, cost-reduction analysis, excess inventory consignment, MRP support, last-time-buy fulfillment, and end-of-life replacement sourcing.

The company serves OEMs, contract manufacturers, and repair depots across the electronics industry, including blue-chip OEMs that rely on its dedicated sales contacts for fast, flexible solutions. Customers range from printed circuit board assemblers needing scheduled deliveries to emergency sourcing for line-stop situations.

Legend Electronics differentiates itself through a personal-service model that assigns each account a single point of contact, an ISO 9001:2015 quality system covering every order, and a lot-level transparency that lets buyers verify exactly what ships. Its services also help clients recapitalize surplus and redundant inventory through immediate purchase evaluations and consignment programs.

name: Levison Enterprises
old_description: When your industrial electronics, devices, or power supplies fail, you need to find an electronics repair solution quickly. Levison Enterprises specializes in electronic repair services tailored to fix current and legacy electronic projects and keep your operations running smoothly. Even when original PCB or Gerber files are unavailable, our experienced engineering team can diagnose and repair issues.
about:
Levison Enterprises operates from a 15,000-square-foot facility in Millbury, Ohio, where it has been based since 2014. The company traces its roots to an AC plasma display manufacturer that evolved into a full-service electronic contract manufacturer as printed-circuit-board technology advanced. President David M. Levison leads the privately held business, which emphasizes a culture of continuous improvement and customer partnership.

The shop provides design-to-build and build-to-print services spanning PCB assembly, cable and wire-harness fabrication, electronic repair and diagnostics, PCB design and engineering, rapid prototyping, and legacy-product reverse engineering. Its ESD-safe epoxy-coated production floor supports medical-device, aerospace, defense, food-safety, and industrial electronics programs. On-site engineers collaborate with clients from concept through supply-chain management and final test, and the company maintains a vetted supply chain with counterfeit-part mitigation.

Levison serves military and aerospace contractors (AS9100), medical-device OEMs (ISO 13485), food-safety equipment makers, and commercial industrial clients. Case studies reference Seagate Mobile Security Solutions, sanitation-testing systems, and legacy displays dating to the 1960s. The firm is ITAR registered and pursuing CMMC compliance for defense work.

The company states its differentiators as a domestic turnkey model with single-point project management, on-site engineering for real-time problem solving, PFMEA-driven process controls, and a quality framework anchored by ISO 9001, AS9100, and ISO 13485 certifications from NSF-ISR. Leadership targets 100 percent quality, on-time delivery, and customer satisfaction.

name: Leviton
old_description: Manufactures electrical wiring devices including switches, sockets, and outlets.
about:
Leviton was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Melville, New York. The company has remained a privately held manufacturer of electrical wiring devices for over a century.

Leviton manufactures a broad range of electrical products including switches, dimmers, outlets, lighting controls, AFCI breakers, fusion splicing solutions, load centers, and data center infrastructure. The company also develops the My Leviton app for unified smart home control of lighting, load management, and EV charging. Recent investments include a $100 million global capital expansion to accelerate AI and smart building network infrastructure, as well as increased high-fiber-count production capacity for data center deployments.

Leviton serves the electrical, lighting, data networking, and energy management sectors. Its customer base includes residential homeowners and installers, commercial and industrial facilities, data center operators, utility companies for submetering, and marine applications for dockside power. The Leviton Load Center is designed for residential new builds, while the Series 2500 submeter targets utility energy management, and the Arc-Arrest pin-and-sleeve devices address marine and industrial power connections.

The company emphasizes its 120-year legacy of quality, safety, and forward-thinking design as a differentiator, citing engineering, real-world insight, and customer-focused partnership. Leviton has also committed to achieving company-wide carbon neutrality by 2030.

name: Lewis Woodshop LLC
old_description: Lewis Woodshop is a custom woodshop located in rural Essex, Vermont that produces fine, heirloom-quality furniture. Using locally sourced materials, David builds each piece from hand, incorporating various styles, including Shaker, Japanese Kumiko and modern. Whether you want furniture that evokes the warmth and sophistication of Europe, the precision and architecture of Asuka-era Japan, or the rugged authenticity of Vermont, Lewis Woodshop has all your needs covered.
about:
Lewis Woodshop operates from a 1,000-square-foot workshop in Essex, Vermont, a rural town about 20 minutes from Burlington. The business was founded by David Lewis after he discovered a passion for fine woodworking while attending the Vermont Woodworking School. A native of Lutherville, Maryland, Lewis spent childhood summers in Vermont’s Green Mountains and now lives in Essex with his family, running the shop as a solo craftsman.

The shop produces heirloom-quality custom furniture, blending Shaker, Japanese Kumiko, and modern design influences. Each piece is built by hand using a mix of power tools and traditional hand tools such as chisels, saws, and sanders. Lewis works exclusively with locally sourced, sustainably harvested hardwoods, completing one project at a time from design through finish.

Clients are typically individual homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind tables, dressers, beds, and decorative items such as Kumiko lanterns. The shop also collaborates on custom commissions, guiding customers through wood selection, style, and design. There is no standard product line; every item is made to order.

Lewis positions the work as functional art, emphasizing museum-level craftsmanship and a dedication to the harmony of utility and aesthetics. The approach is rooted in the belief that handcrafted furniture should be valued for generations, a philosophy reflected in the shop’s tagline, “Exceptionally Yours.”

name: Lexco Cable Manufacturing
old_description: Lexco specializes in supplying steel cable ends and wire rope cable ends for OEMs and industrial buyers who require precise, load-rated termination solutions. Each fitting is selected or manufactured based on application-specific requirements including load capacity, environment, connection type, and installation method.
about:
Lexco Cable Manufacturing operates from Norridge, Illinois, where it has produced custom wire rope, cable, and bungee cord assemblies since 1974. The family-owned company began as a specialist in load-rated termination solutions for OEMs and industrial buyers, growing into a full-service fabricator of wire rope fittings, push-pull controls, architectural cable railings, and related hardware.

The shop handles custom cut-to-length wire rope, crimping, swaging, and assembly of fittings such as end terminals, turnbuckles, and lanyards. Capabilities span prototype through high-volume runs with flexible order quantities and low minimums. Lexco's ISO 9001-certified quality system covers engineering support, first-article inspection, and traceability for aerospace, defense, and commercial programs.

Customers include military prime contractors, OEMs in fitness and agriculture, MRO distributors, general contractors, and aftermarket sellers. The company's product line addresses applications from aircraft cable assemblies meeting MIL-DTL-83420 to bungee cords for tethering and sign hanging, with a configurator that lets buyers specify diameter, construction, coating, and end fittings.

Lexco differentiates itself by combining custom fabrication with practical production support—quick turnarounds, low order minimums, and application-specific engineering. Fifty years of continuous operation under the same ownership have built a knowledge base that the company leverages to help customers select the right cable, fitting, and assembly method for each load and environment.

name: Lighting Virginia
old_description: Lighting Virginia is a statewide agency that provides innovative lighting solutions. We enthusiastically represent the finest manufacturers of quality lighting products. Our combined experience of more than three centuries enables us to work closely with specifiers and contractors – from the early concept stages of a project through the project’s completion. Lighting Virginia is committed to supporting our customers with a high level of energy and integrity.
about:
Lighting Virginia operates as a statewide lighting agency headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia. The firm represents a curated roster of lighting manufacturers and serves specifiers and contractors across the commonwealth. While its founding year is not publicly disclosed, the agency notes that its team brings a combined experience of more than three centuries to each project.

The agency does not manufacture products itself; instead, it acts as a manufacturer’s representative, connecting architects, engineers, and contractors with lighting lines suited to commercial, institutional, and residential projects. Its services span product specification, lighting design assistance, value engineering, and project management from concept through installation. The firm maintains showrooms in Roanoke, Richmond, and Virginia Beach, offering physical and virtual access to product lines from brands such as Modern Forms, Alora, Kuzco, and MP Lighting.

Lighting Virginia’s client base consists primarily of architecture and design firms, electrical contractors, and facility owners throughout Virginia. The agency has collaborated on projects with firms including Baskervill, Glave & Holmes Architecture, Commonwealth Architects, and HKS, Inc., providing lighting specifications for educational, healthcare, hospitality, and civic buildings.

The agency emphasizes a consultative approach, positioning itself as a design partner rather than a product reseller. Leadership stresses long-term relationships and a deep understanding of design intent, aiming to elevate projects through thoughtful lighting solutions rather than simply supplying fixtures.

name: Lima Sheet Metal
old_description: Family-owned and operated since 1974, serving Ohio with quality metal
about:
Lima Sheet Metal has operated from Lima, Ohio since 1974, when founder Michael Ray Emerick opened a small fabrication shop to serve the local community. The business remains family-owned and women-owned, now in its third generation under the leadership of CEO Anne Emerick, President James "Bo" Emerick, and General Manager Steve Emerick.

The company runs a full-service machine shop offering sheet metal fabrication, structural steel work, ventilation and duct systems, material handling equipment, and custom machining. In-house capabilities include CNC and manual machining, MIG/TIG/stick welding, press brakes with 12-foot capacity, a plasma cutting table, and certified confined space entry for tank and vessel work. They also provide on-site installation, emergency welding repair, and specialized fabrication for food and restaurant facilities.

Lima Sheet Metal serves industrial, commercial, and municipal customers throughout Ohio. Its client base includes manufacturers needing custom enclosures, guardrails, and production line components, as well as food-processing plants requiring sanitary stainless steel equipment and ventilation hoods.

The firm emphasizes complete in-house control from design through installation, fast turnaround on quotes (within 24 hours), and emergency repair services to minimize downtime. Three generations of the Emerick family oversee a team of certified welders and machinists who maintain rigorous quality standards on every project.

name: Lincare
old_description: REMsafe SLEEP®, one of our family of businesses and a leading provider of sleep apnea solutions, has announced a new business relationship with TCW, a leading warehousing and distribution company. This relationship will provide offer TCW's fleet of 500 drivers with state-of-the-art sleep apnea treatment.
about:
Lincare is headquartered in Rolla, Missouri. The company operates as a family of businesses that includes REMsafe SLEEP®, a sleep apnea solutions provider. No founding year or founders are disclosed in the available sources.

Lincare delivers in-home respiratory care services nationwide, offering home oxygen therapy, sleep apnea treatment (CPAP and BiPAP), nebulizer therapy, home INR testing, and a range of durable medical equipment (DME) including mobility aids and sleep therapy supplies. The company also provides enteral therapy, high-frequency chest wall oscillation, powered mobility devices, long-term care respiratory programs, pediatric services, pharmacy delivery, pulmonary education, speech generating devices, tracheostomy and suction therapy, and both invasive and non-invasive ventilator therapy. Digital tools such as the VentCircle™ mobile app and a secure patient portal support supply ordering, billing, and therapy tracking.

The company serves patients with chronic respiratory conditions, sleep disorders, and congestive heart failure, as well as long-term care facilities and nursing homes. A noted business relationship includes providing sleep apnea treatment to TCW’s fleet of 500 drivers. Lincare distributes equipment from brands such as B Medical (Luna G3, Luna II), Drive Medical (DeVilbiss Traveler Portable Nebulizer, Power Neb Ultra Compressor), Medline Industries (Aeromist Compact Compressor), and Vesco Medical (Q Enteral Feeding Pump).

Lincare states its mission is to set the standard for excellence in home respiratory care, aiming to enable patients with chronic conditions to remain engaged in life. Differentiators include the CareCheck™ COPD early-intervention program, the HeartSteps® congestive heart failure management program, and the SleepEaze™ sleep disorder education and assessment program.

name: Linear Fine Woodworking
old_description: Linear Fine Woodworking provides beautiful custom-built cabinetry and architectural millwork to areas like Phoenix and Scottsdale Arizona as well as the greater Southwest. Each Linear Fine Woodworking creation is a work of art crafted and custom-built just for you. Whether it’s custom designed kitchen cabinetry, a wall unit, home theatre unit, or office furniture, innovation in design and woodworking is a hallmark of Linear Fine Woodworking products.
about:
Linear Fine Woodworking operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it has been designing and building custom furniture, cabinetry, and architectural millwork for over 30 years. The shop serves clients across Phoenix, Scottsdale, and the broader Southwest region.

The company produces custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, and one-of-a-kind furniture pieces such as kitchen cabinets, wall units, home theater systems, and office furniture. A distinguishing capability is the in-house production of veneer panels from rough-cut flitches, a process that yields uniformly even, stable panels and allows greater design flexibility. The workshop works with exotic veneers, solid woods, glass, integrated lighting, cables, and specialty hardware.

Projects span both residential and commercial sectors. Homeowners, interior designers, architects, and business owners commission Linear Fine Woodworking for custom residential woodworking, commercial millwork, and specialized installations including hospitality and office environments.

The firm emphasizes that its in-house veneer manufacturing sets it apart from typical cabinet shops, enabling a level of creativity that blurs the line between functional cabinetry and sculpture. Innovation in design and woodworking is cited as a hallmark of every project.
